panels.title: BTC Current Spot vs Open Strike

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    observed_at_ms / 1000 AS time,
    CAST(json_extract(normalized_json, '$.current_spot') AS REAL) AS spot,
    CAST(json_extract(normalized_json, '$.open_strike') AS REAL) AS strike
FROM raw_events
WHERE json_extract(normalized_json, '$.current_spot') IS NOT NULL
  AND json_extract(normalized_json, '$.open_strike') IS NOT NULL
  AND (observed_at_ms / 1000 >= $__unixEpochFrom() AND observed_at_ms / 1000 <= $__unixEpochTo())
ORDER BY observed_at_ms ASC;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    observed_at_ms / 1000 AS time,
    ROUND(CAST(json_extract(normalized_json, '$.yes_bid') AS REAL) * 100.0, 1) AS yes_bid_cents,
    ROUND(CAST(json_extract(normalized_json, '$.yes_ask') AS REAL) * 100.0, 1) AS yes_ask_cents,
    ROUND(CAST(json_extract(normalized_json, '$.no_bid') AS REAL) * 100.0, 1) AS no_bid_cents,
    ROUND(CAST(json_extract(normalized_json, '$.no_ask') AS REAL) * 100.0, 1) AS no_ask_cents
FROM raw_events
WHERE topic = 'kalshi.15m.market'
  AND (observed_at_ms / 1000 >= $__unixEpochFrom() AND observed_at_ms / 1000 <= $__unixEpochTo())
ORDER BY observed_at_ms ASC;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    t.trade_id,
    t.participant_id,
    t.experiment_id,
    t.strategy_id,
    t.cycle_id,
    t.ticker,
    t.side,
    t.contracts,
    ROUND(t.entry_price, 4) AS entry_price,
    ROUND(t.cost, 2) AS cost,
    t.status,
    t.exit_reason,
    ROUND(t.exit_price, 4) AS exit_price,
    ROUND(t.pnl, 2) AS pnl,
    CASE WHEN t.won = 1 THEN 'WIN' WHEN t.won = 0 THEN 'LOSS' ELSE 'OPEN' END AS outcome,
    t.opened_at_ms,
    t.closed_at_ms
FROM strategy_trades t
WHERE ('$participant' = 'All' OR t.participant_id = '$participant')
  AND ('$experiment' = 'All' OR t.experiment_id = '$experiment')
  AND ('$strategy' = 'All' OR t.strategy_id = '$strategy')
ORDER BY t.opened_at_ms DESC
LIMIT 100;

    o.output_id,
    o.participant_id,
    o.experiment_id,
    o.strategy_id,

    o.output_kind,
    o.log_line,

FROM strategy_outputs o
WHERE ('$participant' = 'All' OR o.participant_id = '$participant')

  AND ('$strategy' = 'All' OR o.strategy_id = '$strategy')
ORDER BY o.ts_ms DESC
